components.name: Text Field

components.css: .ds-field{display:block;color:var(--foreground,#292c29);font:500 14px/1.2 Inter,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-field input{display:block;width:100%;height:44px;margin-top:8px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--input,#d6d0c4);border-radius:10px;background:var(--background,#faf7f0);color:var(--foreground,#292c29);font:400 16px/1.5 Inter,Arial,sans-serif;outline:0;transition:border-color 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:var(--border,#ded8cc)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--ring,#35675b);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring,#35675b) 20%,transparent)}

components.name: Continue Panel
components.description: The library's single broad featured book panel.
components.css: .ds-continue{display:grid;grid-template-columns:96px 1fr;gap:24px;align-items:center;padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--border,#ded8cc);border-radius:14px;background:var(--card,#fdfbf7);color:var(--foreground,#292c29)}.ds-cover{display:grid;place-items:center;width:96px;aspect-ratio:2/3;border-radius:10px;background:var(--primary,#173f36);color:var(--primary-foreground,#fbfaf5);font:400 40px 'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif;box-shadow:0 16px 38px -24px rgba(18,60,53,.65)}.ds-continue small{letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--muted-foreground,#686b66)}.ds-continue h2{margin:10px 0 4px;font:400 36px/1.1 'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif}.ds-continue p{margin:0 0 20px;color:var(--muted-foreground,#686b66);font:14px Inter,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-continue button{height:44px;padding:0 16px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:var(--primary,#173f36);color:var(--primary-foreground,#fbfaf5)}.ds-continue button:hover{opacity:.8}.ds-continue button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#35675b);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
Miraf, ምዕራፍ, means “chapter.” The product feels like opening a well-kept personal reading ledger: warm paper, deep green ink, fine rules, real book covers, and literary type organize a private collection without slipping into nostalgia. It is spacious and precise, with the current book and next reading action always leading the composition.

Authentication, library, synchronization, and recovery states all belong to this same visual world. Account surfaces use the forest-green brand field more expansively; operational states stay quiet and local to the decision at hand. Once a book opens, the interface recedes further so the EPUB page—not application chrome—owns attention.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper canvases with deep forest actions and fine ledger rules.
Instrument Serif for literary identity; Inter for precise controls and status copy.
One broad continuation panel followed by ruled editorial rows, never a dashboard grid.
Sync is invisible when healthy and explicit only when the reader must understand or act.
Reader chrome inherits the chosen page theme and remains quieter than the library.

rules.name: The Quiet Green Rule
rules.body: Forest Ink is purposeful and relatively scarce on library screens; healthy synchronization never earns another green badge.

rules.name: The State Needs Meaning Rule
rules.body: Error Red denotes a failed or destructive state, not urgency theater. Offline and in-progress states use Quiet Text with an icon and plain label.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif names the place, book, or moment; Inter explains state and enables action. Do not use display type for validation, sync copy, buttons, or dense metadata.

rules.name: The One Broad Panel Rule
rules.body: The continuation feature is the library’s only broad bordered panel. Migration is a muted inline callout; ordinary books are ruled rows.

rules.name: The Page Owns the Reader Rule
rules.body: Never add permanent sidebars or dashboard furniture that reduce the book unless the reader explicitly opens a sheet.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest on rules and tonal layering; shadows are reserved for physical book covers and controls that genuinely float above the page.

rules.name: The Ledger Edge Rule
rules.body: Radius belongs to discrete controls and intentional panels, never every content group. Do not turn the library into nested rounded cards.

dos: Do preserve Chapter Ledger hierarchy across authentication, library, sync, and recovery.
Do keep covers visible on mobile and long-form text at a readable measure.
Do show sync state only when it changes what the reader understands or can do.
Do explain errors in one sentence and pair recoverable failures with one action.
Do keep controls at least 40px, preferably 44px, with accessible names and visible focus.
Do reduce nonessential animation for prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
donts: Don't turn the library into a dashboard, repeat books in heavy cards, or add promotional statistics.
Don't add gradients, oversized shadows, ornamental book motifs, faux paper, glass panels, or decorative badges.
Don't show success badges on synced books or expose technical cloud/cache language in primary flows.
Don't invent covers, metadata, quotations, reading statistics, claims, or proof.
Don't let reader chrome compete with the page or hide essential controls behind hover.
Don't use color alone for progress, errors, selection, offline, or sync status.
